body.name: \(\vartheta_B\)
body.construction: Choose \(\vartheta_B=((\ell_i)_{i=1}^B,(c_{ji}^a)_{a,j,i})\) with \(\ell_i\ge0\), \(\sum_i\ell_i=\Delta\), and \(c_{ji}^a\in[0,L]\). For any piecewise-constant pair \((g_i,d_i)\), set \(V_0=1\), \(V_i=V_{i-1}e^{-(g_i+d_i)\ell_i}\), \(P=\sum_iV_{i-1}g_iE(g_i+d_i,\ell_i)\), and \(Q=\sum_iV_{i-1}d_iE(g_i+d_i,\ell_i)\). Impose \((P_a,Q_a,V_a)=(p_a,q_a,s_a)\) for both factual arms and optimize \(R+vV\) after applying the same recursion to \((c_{1i}^1,c_{2i}^0)\).
